thread:
Zara K: Quick newbie question: who do I message for model routing issues vs infra capacity vs Dedicated billing? Trying to make a small 'who-to-ping' sticky.

Nate P: Short sticky: routing -> #eng-runtime, infra/capacity -> #eng-infra, incidents/oncall -> #eng-sre, Dedicated billing -> eng-platform-saas@redwood.com.

Rina: Add that eng-runtime handles pin/rollback and routing policies. For a suspected capacity shortage for a Dedicated customer ping eng-platform and include the customer ID and timeframe.

Zara K: Any templates for pages or rollbacks I should use?

Nate P: Use this simple rollback template in #eng-runtime: "EMERGENCY ROLLBACK: cust=<id> req=<rid> action=pin:<model>@<version> reason=<latency/regression>". If paging infra include request-id and trace-id.

ops-bot: NOTE: Pages without request-id or sample payload take longer. Include logs or redwoodctl traces when possible.

Zara K: Great, adding to my onboarding notes. Thanks!
